show.description: Wani’s world shatters when she discovers that Shekhar Pratap Singh, the powerful mafia-politician she loves — is secretly obsessed with her manipulative stepsister Tripti, forcing her into a painful marriage with blind Arnav and igniting a dark battle of betrayal, obsession, and revenge.
